{{Quote|Our men will re-capture the freighter and guide it back home. However, you must protect it from incoming Zynt'aia pirate attacks. No doubt, they'll try to destroy the freighter now that we've rescued it.|[[A'Lerris Verata]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:DD45C" />}}
The '''''Darksing D-45''''' was a [[heavy freighter]] owned by the [[Nallera's mining crew]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DD45C" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the ship was captured by the [[Zynt'aia Spice Guardians|Zynt'aia pirates]] but it was eventually recaptured by the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] forces dispatched by Mining Chief Operator [[A'Lerris Verata]].<ref name="SWG:DD45C" />
{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Darksing D-45'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DD45C" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Darksing D-45'' was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DD45C" />
